_README: Single source of truth for client reviews rendered on the site. Text is VERBATIM and must never be reworded. ATTRIBUTION (Lisa, 24 July 2026 standing rule, applied in Batch 2b): every reviewer's name is displayed EXACTLY as it appears on their Google / Facebook / Realtor.com / Zillow review — no first-name-plus-initial truncation, no case normalization ('leani lopez', 'Mickel,f Izaguirre', 'fitness_pacojf P.F', 'EliteGodGamer', 'Anidem' are all platform-exact). lang = the language the review was ORIGINALLY written in. es_translation / en_translation = labeled renderings used ONLY on the opposite-language pages, always shown with the 'Traducido del ingles' / 'Translated from Spanish' label; a translation is never presented as the original. A null translation means the review may NOT appear on the other language's pages at all. person = cross-platform identity key used to de-duplicate the same human appearing on two platforms. household = married couples / immediate family, never placed on the same page. EXCLUDED and not present in this file: lenders Sergio Gomez, Lucia Sanchez, Zachary Fletcher (RESPA, and the source doc classes them as not client testimonials); Matt McCarthy (vendor, not a client); Francisco G. Collio (Lisa's husband — an About-page fact, never a testimonial); Gloria Orellana Saez (the review turns on religion, a protected class — Fair Housing gate outranks the batch instruction. DECIDED by Lisa, 25 July 2026: keep excluded permanently. This is settled — do not re-raise it or re-add her in a later batch, even though Batch 2b §2/§3 still list her as ES-eligible; those lines predate the decision. Her review may not be truncated or edited to remove the religious reference either, because reviews are always verbatim); Jordi B photos and the Yaquelin Lozano -1/-2 pair (no photo permission on file; Jordi B's review TEXT is eligible and is included, text-only).

reviews.name: fitness_pacojf P.F
reviews.text: Tuve la oportunidad de trabajar con Lisa Collio y puedo afirmar que es una agente inmobiliaria altamente profesional, destacada por su respeto, compromiso y, sobre todo, su honestidad. En todo momento demostró una atención excepcional, respondiendo con rapidez y claridad a cada una de mis consultas, incluso fuera del horario habitual. Su acompañamiento fue fundamental para lograr la compra de mi vivienda, brindando confianza y tranquilidad durante todo el proceso. Además, el hecho de que hable español fue una gran ayuda, ya que facilitó la comunicación y permitió que cada detalle se entendiera perfectamente. Recomiendo ampliamente sus servicios por su dedicación, ética y excelencia profesional, muchas gracias.
reviews.en_translation: I had the opportunity to work with Lisa Collio, and I can confidently say that she is a highly professional real estate agent, distinguished by her respect, commitment, and above all, her honesty. At all times, she provided exceptional attention, responding quickly and clearly to each of my inquiries—even outside of regular business hours. Her guidance was essential in achieving the purchase of my home, providing confidence and peace of mind throughout the entire process. In addition, the fact that she speaks Spanish was a great help, as it made communication easier and ensured that every detail was perfectly understood. I highly recommend her services for her dedication, integrity, and professional excellence. Thank you.
